related.title: AMD MI300：HBM 容量與模型駐留
related.titleEn: AMD MI300: HBM capacity and model residency
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：首批、穩態與尾批皆可由時序重建，佇列不無限成長，未假定所有階段共享資源仍能完全重疊。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: First, steady and final timings reproduce with bounded queues and explicitly independent resources.
related.difference: 以容量帳本決定可同時服務的請求數，保留碎片與暫存餘量。
related.differenceEn: Use a capacity ledger to bound concurrent requests while reserving workspace and fragmentation headroom.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 三段完全串行時 T=a+b+c；三段獨立可重疊時穩態批間隔至少 max(a,b,c)，首批仍需全部三段。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 合成每批主機處理12 ms、傳送4 ms、MXU計算8 ms；無競爭且緩衝足夠。 串行24 ms/批；重疊後12 ms/批，吞吐約83.333批/s。最初24 ms延遲沒有消失。
可用KV容量=總容量−權重−暫存−保留量；每請求容量固定時以向下取整決定上限。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 假想加速器80 GiB，權重28 GiB、暫存8 GiB、保留4 GiB，每請求KV2.5 GiB。 KV餘量=80−28−8−4=40 GiB；40/2.5=16個請求。未包含長度變動時的額外增長。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Serial latency is a+b+c; independent overlapped stages have interval at least max(a, b, c), while first-batch latency still spans all stages. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Synthetic per-batch stages:12 ms host processing, 4 ms transfer, 8 ms compute, with independent resources and sufficient buffers. Serial execution takes24 ms/batch; overlap gives12 ms intervals, 83.333 batches/s; initial24 ms latency remains.

Available KV capacity equals total minus weights, workspace and reserve; divide by per-request usage and round down. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Hypothetical80 GiB accelerator, 28 GiB weights, 8 GiB workspace, 4 GiB reserve and 2.5 GiB KV/request. KV headroom=80−28−8−4=40 GiB; 40/2.5=16 requests, before additional growth from variable lengths.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: NVDLA：卷積緩衝與 bank 配置
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：首批、穩態與尾批皆可由時序重建，佇列不無限成長，未假定所有階段共享資源仍能完全重疊。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: First, steady and final timings reproduce with bounded queues and explicitly independent resources.
related.difference: 以bank為最小配置單位檢查雙緩衝，辨識容量足夠但bank分配不合法的情況。
related.differenceEn: Check double buffering at bank granularity, including configurations that fit by bytes but not by banks.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 三段完全串行時 T=a+b+c；三段獨立可重疊時穩態批間隔至少 max(a,b,c)，首批仍需全部三段。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 合成每批主機處理12 ms、傳送4 ms、MXU計算8 ms；無競爭且緩衝足夠。 串行24 ms/批；重疊後12 ms/批，吞吐約83.333批/s。最初24 ms延遲沒有消失。
配置量需對每個獨立區段向上取整到bank；不能先加總再只取整一次。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學bank32 KiB，共16 bank；每份特徵70 KiB、權重50 KiB，特徵雙緩衝、權重單份。 特徵每份3 bank、權重2 bank，總3×2+2=8 bank。原始190 KiB需配置256 KiB。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Serial latency is a+b+c; independent overlapped stages have interval at least max(a, b, c), while first-batch latency still spans all stages. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Synthetic per-batch stages:12 ms host processing, 4 ms transfer, 8 ms compute, with independent resources and sufficient buffers. Serial execution takes24 ms/batch; overlap gives12 ms intervals, 83.333 batches/s; initial24 ms latency remains.

Round each independent allocation up to a bank; rounding only the total can undercount. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching banks32 KiB, 16 banks total; each feature70 KiB, weights50 KiB, two feature buffers and one weight buffer. Each feature needs3 banks, weights2, total 3×2+2=8 banks; 190 KiB payload allocates256 KiB.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
